scenario: A cardiology authorization relay should reopen only after the authorization ticket, provider message, insurer message, requirement note, and case note still converge on the same fresh referral lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the cardiology authorization relay for case MED-1642. Start from authorization ticket AUT-1642, rebuild the support trail it references, and only take the approved close step if the relay still lines up.

medical_authorization_case_tickets.body_text: Authorization ticket AUT-1642: rebuild the cardiology relay by checking provider message PM-1642, insurer message IM-1642, requirement note RQN-1642, and case note CN-1642. If no active cardiology referral remains and the late relay still aligns, the approved close step is to submit a fresh cardiology referral.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1642: the previous cardiology intake slot expired after the authorization bridge stalled. Reopen the lane only through a fresh cardiology referral.

medical_insurer_messages.body_text: Insurer message IM-1642: once the authorization relay is rebuilt and there is no active cardiology referral left on MED-1642, the approved close step is a fresh cardiology referral.

medical_referral_requirement_notes.body_text: Requirement note RQN-1642: submit a new cardiology referral only after the expired relay is fully rebuilt and no active cardiology referral remains.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1642: the relay still closes through the fresh cardiology referral lane once every supporting carrier lines up.
